completeSelectedRecords.name: Mental Buffer

sourceObject.name: Mental Buffer
sourceObject.description: Wisdom 15+ supports the feat's listed once-per-day defense against confusion.
sourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, when you would become confused, dominated, or unable to distinguish allies from enemies, ignore that condition until the end of your next turn.
sourceObject.legacyEffect: Negate confusion once per day
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Define the exact source control components called confused/dominated/mistaken-allies and automatic versus voluntary use. Specify prevention versus suppression until end of next regular turn, underlying duration/save clocks, recurrence, multiple components and reactivation. Do not turn one-turn relief into a cure or unrestricted control immunity.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR, when a new source application would impose confusion/randomized action selection, a dominated/commanded Action or turn, or an explicit inability to distinguish friend from foe, voluntarily suppress only that application’s eligible control components through the end of your next future regular turn. No Action/Reaction is required; choose before those components first take effect. NEW qualify by actual written behavior, not a condition’s suggestive name. Ordinary Charmed/Frightened alone, illusion disbelief, blindness, truthful uncertainty and incapacity without such a component do not qualify. Preserve unrelated damage/slow and the original source, duration, concentration, repeat saves and spent hard-control entitlement. Suppressed clocks continue; legal ending saves still occur. If the original component has already expired or been cured by the boundary it never returns; otherwise it resumes for its remaining duration without replaying a past commanded turn. One application only, not immunity to later separate sources.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Voluntary temporary component suppression, with unchanged original clocks and no replayed command.
submittedWorkedCases: A dominated Action scheduled inside the protected interval is skipped, not stored for a later extra command.
Another source’s independent Stunned effect remains operative.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt one bounded delayed application interval for supported confusion/misidentification control; no arbitrary condition cure or replay of suppressed pulses.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR at cast declaration choose a real reflective surface you can see within 60 ft of your actual body. NEW require an unobstructed line of effect from you to that surface, at least hand-sized, sufficiently exposed to form a recognizable reflection; a drawn picture of a mirror is insufficient. Choose an unoccupied origin point immediately at its visible face. Measure spell range/line of effect and area orientation from that point; you still must personally perceive targets where the spell requires it, receiving no remote senses. Self-area/cone origins can relocate, but a Self-only body buff still affects you and Touch spells still require actual touch; no remote grasp. Hostile-held surfaces may serve if visibly legal; no possession or movement of the object. Commit ordinary costs/components/feat use at your body, preserving its interruption window. The origin is snapshotted for immediate resolution; destruction before resolution fails the changed origin with no refund. Ongoing created areas retain their actual fixed/moving rules and deadlines; the mirror is neither a second caster nor an unprinted tether.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Visible substantial surface, body-to-surface line and explicit Self/Touch limits.
submittedWorkedCases: A cone can originate at a visible mirror 40 ft away and point along a chosen legal direction.
An unseen creature behind the mirror gains no free visibility; a Touch heal cannot cross 40 ft through it.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt finite real mirror-origin redirection with actual visibility, line of effect and caster targeting; no remote Touch, mirror-created sight or continuing tether.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At character level 6, NEW choose active+1 rather than legacy/description+2 penetration. Gain+1 on actual spell attack rolls and actual checks explicitly required to overcome magical resistance. Current strongest same-stat bonuses apply. No generic resistance check exists: ordinary damage resistance still halves its eligible damage and spell resistance that grants save advantage is not a caster check. Apply the second branch only to an operative source’s real test. This is not Spell Focus, supplies no saveDCbonus, spell access, damage increase or extra Counterspell/Dispel check. A Counterspell check is interruption, not overcoming magical resistance unless its exact source separately establishes that predicate.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Active+1 and actual-test predicate preserve both clauses without inventing penetration stats.
submittedWorkedCases: A legal spell attack+6 becomes+7 if no stronger applicable flat bonus replaces it.
A creature with fire resistance retains that resistance; there is no new+1 penetration roll.
sourceDirection.decision: Select current+1 spell attacks/real resistance checks over legacy+2 penetration; distinct feat bonuses add, but absent checks are not created.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once SR/LR after your own actual spell is countered, or after every originally legal recipient of its initial save-based payload actually succeeds on every required initial save, optionally commit the use and queue one extra BA for your next future regular turn. NEW require at least one actual initial save and all original recipients resolved legally; a no-save, mixed attack/save or lost-target cast cannot qualify by vacuous success. An automatic successful save counts where a real save was called for. No copying/echoing or each-tick retrigger. The BA becomes available on that one regular turn, even if other BA is spent, and expires unused at its end; incapacity creates no makeup. It may perform an actually acquired legal BA, including ordinary command, but cannot prepare/cast a ranked spell or create more actions/banked allowances. It does not bypass shared companion offense, concentration, RP or other use caps. No extra fullAction, Reaction or duration-clock tick.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: One queued regular-turn BA and explicit all-initial-target success predicate.
submittedWorkedCases: Both targets succeed on the spell’s only two initial saves: next regular turn gains one restricted BA.
One target failed but was immune to damage: the all-success branch does not trigger.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt extra bounded non-ranked-spell BA only after actual countering or all initial recipients genuinely saving; no empty-set trigger or extra full Action.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR at damaging spell declaration, add one existing native damage die per actual spell rank to one immediate native packet under the shared added-die rule. NEW choose this active rule over legacy 25%. Commit use with the cast. After its immediate attempted resolution, including a miss, all saves or Counterspell, take 2×rank force backlash as one self-damage event. This damage cannot be reduced or redirected; NEW it does pass through real temp HP before normal HP, unlike the explicitly proposed normal HP-funded blood costs. Resolve ordinary Wound/death/concentration consequences and no incidental reflection/resource/lifesteal triggers from this self-authored cost. It requires noHPprepayment and can kill the caster. A readied cast takes backlash after preparation/interruption, not after eventual release; its added dice attach once to the eventual immediate payload. Rank 0 legally adds 0 dice and 0 damage but still spends the use if chosen. Flat-only/no-native-die spells are ineligible.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: One native packet, post-attempt backlash including counters, and explicit temp HP-compatible damage rather than HP funding.
submittedWorkedCases: Rank 3 native 4d6 becomes 7d6 in the selected shared area roll, followed by 6 unreducible force backlash.
If Counterspell negates that spell, the committedLRuse and 6 backlash still occur.

originalSourceObject.name: Planar Knowledge
originalSourceObject.description: Intelligence 14+ supports recognizing an enemy's resistances in the middle of a fight.
originalSourceObject.effect: As a bonus action, make an Arcana check against DC 10 + the creature’s challenge rating. On a success, learn one resistance, immunity, vulnerability, or planar trait. Once per creature.
originalSourceObject.legacyEffect: Know enemy resistances mid-fight
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per actual creature identity, as a Bonus Action examine one creature you can perceive within 60 ft and line of effect. NEW commit the per-creature attempt before rolling INT(Arcana) against DC 10+its actual printedCR, rounding the finalDCdown by current fraction rules. If noCR is assigned, Director must establish the encounter’s rating before attempts; absence is notCR 0 and an unsupported target is ineligible without spending. Success lets the Director truthfully disclose one existing damage resistance, immunity, vulnerability or explicitly established planar-trait fact; you may name a category, but no nonexistent fact is invented. If that category has none, report that absence only, not all other hidden data. Failure gives no fact and no retry through alias/form/encounter reset. Existing source disguises/protected information still apply. Planar traits requiring the deferred cosmology review remain unasserted; other recorded defenses are still usable.

sourceDirection.decision: Keep bounded observable ordinary defensive information and explicit no-cosmology scope; NEW DC15 fallback for otherwise eligible genuinely unrated creatures, never invented CR.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At character level 6, after a completed personal ranked cast gain+1 AC until your next future regular start. NEW select active+1/regular-start over preserved 10%/5 seconds. It begins after the cast’s immediate resolution or successful Ready preparation, so does not protect against that cast’s earlier interruption attacks. Ready release does not grant again. Incapacity does not itself end this nonconcentration buff; ordinary expiry/source-suppression does. No additional armor, resistance, spell use or cast trigger from copies.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For a spell you can actually cast through a legal ritual route, halve only the route’s additional ritual time, with resulting additional time at least 5 minutes; retain the base printed casting time in full. NEW measure the result in elapsed seconds and round up to the next whole second so fractions never shorten a required interval. An original 10 minute addition becomes 5 minutes, not half the whole cast. An original shorter addition is not increased: use min(original additional time, max(300, ceil(original/2))). This explicit non-worsening interpretation preserves the minimum for reductions without penalizing a preexisting faster route. Components, formula/repertoire, costs, concentration, helpers and interruptions remain. It grants no Ritual tag or access; the separate proposed Ritual Caster overlay needs its own approval. Apply this additional-time change before any separately legal group active-time adjustment, whose minimum rule remains.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Additional-time-only arithmetic, no worsening of already-shorter routes and second rounding.
submittedWorkedCases: A 1 Action base plus 10 minutes ritual addition becomes the same 1 Action base plus 5 minutes.
A source’s 2 minute special addition stays 2 minutes, and this feat creates no ritual permission.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt half the added ritual labor, not base cast time, with a non-worsening five-minute floor and explicit composition with Ritual Channeler.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW a group ritual is one actual legally available ritual spell with a designated lead and at least one physically present willing assistant continuously performing that same ritual’s active work; it is not simultaneous crafting, travel or independent casts. Use the exact source’s assistant qualifications/cap. If it supplies none, the proposed default assistant must know that ritual or have proficiency in the lead’s actual relevant Arcana/Religion/Nature skill; count at most two ordinary assistant contributions, with no numeric roll bonus when the source has no assistant benefit. This feat-holder contributes as two ordinary assistants within that cap, never as two leads or two physical bodies for a separate location requirement. One or more holders reduce the group’s total active casting time once by 25%, rounding up seconds; passive waiting is unchanged. Apply after Quick Ritualist’s additional-time reduction, but never reduce that remaining additional ritual portion below 5 minutes unless it was already shorter. Source-required simultaneous people, costs, lead concentration, interruptions and minimum times remain. No multiplicative 25%stack or free spell/resource. NEW the double-assistant contribution applies only while actually serving as an assistant. A lead who owns this feat can supply the time reduction but cannot simultaneously count as two assistants; one person never performs both assigned jobs at once.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Finite default group/assistant procedure and single 25%time reduction with preserved minimums.
submittedWorkedCases: A 20 minute fully active ritual with no stronger minimum takes 15 minutes with one qualified Channeler.
Two Channelers do not halve that time again and cannot replace two required bodies at distant ritual stations.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt one25% group-labor reduction and double ordinary assistant contribution only for the actual assistant role; no extra physical bodies, fabricated check or per-helper compounding.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW select 15 ward HP over preserved 50. The feat has one armed grant per beneficial SR/LR; acquisition arms it. At the first real encounter start after arming, automatically create one personal runic ward with 15 points and spend that entitlement, even if surprised/incapacitated; a dead creature receives none. It persists between encounters until depleted or the next beneficial SR/LR, when any old ward ends and entitlement rearms for the next combat, not immediate refill in combat. Repeated initiative does not refill it. This is a distinct spell-only ward, not temp HP: after ordinary defenses and before temp HP, intercept up to its remaining points of actual incoming spell damage in stable component order. Nonspell damage bypasses it. Record ward absorption separately, excluded from actual damage received by the body, Wound/death thresholds and concentration checks; any surviving packet resolves once normally. No transfer, double ledger, HP healing, return on revival or resource proc from ward absorption. Counterspell/dispel cannot target this nonspell passive ward without explicit applicable source permission.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Separate 15 point spell-only pre-temp ward, one armed combat grant per rest and no encounter refills.
submittedWorkedCases: A post-defense 20 spell-damage packet consumes 15 ward then passes 5 to temp HP/normal HP.
A sword’s 8 nonspell damage ignores the ward entirely; starting another encounter does not restore spent ward points.
sourceDirection.decision: Select15 ward HP over legacy50, armed once by an actual beneficial rest and consumed across later encounters until refreshed; no encounter-entry refill farming.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR, NEW spend a Reaction when a hostile pending spell has selected you as its sole creature target, after ordinary cast interruptions but before its attack/save/effect resolution. It must be an actual single-target payload, not one target remaining from an area or multi-target mode. Roll an unmodifiedd 20;16–20 redirects, preserving this explicit 25%procedure over legacy 10%. On success choose a different legal creature under the original spell’s actual target restrictions, range/line measured from the original origin, personally perceived by you where necessary; the original caster remains owner and supplies all stats/choices. Recheck legality, then use fresh original attack/save procedure against that new target; nothing resolves against you. If no legal new target exists, or on 1–15, the spell continues against you with advantage on each actual initial save it requires; no save is invented for an attack/automatic spell. Use/Reaction remain spent. A redirected/reflected/copy packet cannot be redirected again by this family or Spell Reflection. Protected/self-only/source-specific exclusions remain.

completeOriginalProposalRecords.procedure: Once LR, when a new source application would impose confusion/randomized action selection, a dominated/commanded Action or turn, or an explicit inability to distinguish friend from foe, voluntarily suppress only that application’s eligible control components through the end of your next future regular turn. No Action/Reaction is required; choose before those components first take effect. NEW qualify by actual written behavior, not a condition’s suggestive name. Ordinary Charmed/Frightened alone, illusion disbelief, blindness, truthful uncertainty and incapacity without such a component do not qualify. Preserve unrelated damage/slow and the original source, duration, concentration, repeat saves and spent hard-control entitlement. Suppressed clocks continue; legal ending saves still occur. If the original component has already expired or been cured by the boundary it never returns; otherwise it resumes for its remaining duration without replaying a past commanded turn. One application only, not immunity to later separate sources.
completeOriginalProposalRecords.newChoices: Voluntary temporary component suppression, with unchanged original clocks and no replayed command.
workedCases: A dominated Action scheduled inside the protected interval is skipped, not stored for a later extra command.
Another source’s independent Stunned effect remains operative.

Self-area/cone origins can relocate, but a Self-only body buff still affects you and Touch spells still require actual touch; no remote grasp. Hostile-held surfaces may serve if visibly legal; no possession or movement of the object. Commit ordinary costs/components/feat use at your body, preserving its interruption window. The origin is snapshotted for immediate resolution; destruction before resolution fails the changed origin with no refund. Ongoing created areas retain their actual fixed/moving rules and deadlines; the mirror is neither a second caster nor an unprinted tether.

completeOriginalProposalRecords.procedure: For a spell you can actually cast through a legal ritual route, halve only the route’s additional ritual time, with resulting additional time at least 5 minutes; retain the base printed casting time in full. Components, formula/repertoire, costs, concentration, helpers and interruptions remain. It grants no Ritual tag or access; the separate proposed Ritual Caster overlay needs its own approval. Apply this additional-time change before any separately legal group active-time adjustment, whose minimum rule remains.

rules.title: Authority, identity and acquisition
rules.wording:
These are source/proposal-authoring directions for 327 exact existing IDs, not approval of assembled operational cards. Preserve all 335 originals, eight already-reviewed full feats, every description/effect/legacy alternative, original questions, absent/null distinctions and prior labels. A real class-scheduled feat/ASI opportunity pays for a grant; merely reaching a total level, possessing an item, meeting prerequisites or reading this register gives no selection. Unqualified Level means total character level; named Warrior or other class gates use that class level. Check printed permanent ability, actual feat ownership and credential prerequisites at acquisition. A half-feat ability increase is capped at 20, contributes zero rather than reducing a higher score, and does not grant another selection. The pure ASI option requires its full legal allocation. Numerical skill prerequisites require actual proficiency and permanent governing ability modifier plus the applicable normal PB or replacing Expertise contribution, excluding equipment, temporary modifiers, situational feats, Help and advantage. Preserve the acquisition snapshot. Later prerequisite loss does not erase a grant; ongoing equipped/active/body requirements can disable its use.
NEW nonrepeatability: each identity is acquired once, except the explicitly repeatable ASI, Armor Proficiency for a distinct missing tier, Resilient for a different save, and Weapon Focus for a different actual weapon type. Elemental Affinity/Adept, Spell Focus and other chosen-type feats do not gain unprinted repeatability. One same-named source represented in two catalogs is not two selections. The twelve explicitly mapped Warrior mutation-feat pairs are one paid identity; their actual class gates and active-mutation conditions control as stated in HM rows. Other shared names do NOT merge class, ancestry, item, feat, ordinary-spell or supplement permissions.

Warrior mutation-feat acquisition uses the equipped-loadout rules in the Warrior engine as corrected by FEAT327-ACQ-02: at most two equipped Advanced mutations per actual tree and at most one equipped Apex mutation across all trees, within the actual unlocked total slots. Dormant equipped mutations count toward those ceilings. Evaluate each feat's equipped and active prerequisites only at the acquisition or use-time checkpoints that its exact procedure specifies. A temporary all-equipped activation does not supply an equipped prerequisite, slot, mutation, class level or feat opportunity. Preserve each feat's acquisition snapshot and existing ongoing operating conditions.

rules.title: Credentials, training snapshots and real study
rules.wording:
Use actual current credentials, one proficiency contribution and the feat's selected branch. Thievery is the bounded thieves'-tools/DEX acquisition bridge, not a new universal skill. Mechanical Disable Device means an actual Engineering or thieves'-tools disarm interface; it does not authorize magical disarming. Knowledge (Monstrous Humanoids) remains an existing valid legacy credential; proficient INT(Nature) for that bounded anatomy is the NEW alternative bridge, with printed Survival still valid. Culture Lore may be an actual bounded credential or the explicitly selected History specialization. Agility means the stated Dexterity option, not another ability. Spellcraft is not silently aliased to Arcana; an actual legacy credential receipt is required where it is printed as a prerequisite, unless another printed alternative qualifies. Half-elf, Half-orc, Dragonborn, Sorcerer and Warlock labels are not silently turned into present ancestry/class identities. Existing genuinely authorized legacy grants remain evidenced; no new builder option follows.

**Weapon prerequisite bridge.** Apply this bridge only to an actual printed feat prerequisite, subject to any more specific acquisition direction in that feat’s final procedure. Where a prerequisite names a weapon or weapon type, require actual proficiency with that named current weapon profile/type. A generic Melee or Melee Proficiency prerequisite requires actual proficiency with at least one current melee-weapon profile; Ranged or Ranged Proficiency requires actual proficiency with at least one current ranged-weapon profile. Use the weapon profile’s actual classification, not merely the attack’s melee or ranged delivery: throwing a melee-class weapon does not by itself satisfy Ranged acquisition, and making a ranged spell attack supplies no weapon proficiency. An otherwise generic martial-weapon proficiency prerequisite requires proficiency with at least one actual martial-weapon profile, not all martial weapons; an explicitly stricter per-feat prerequisite remains stricter. Two-Handed or 2H Weapon acquisition requires actual proficiency with a weapon whose current profile possesses the Two-Handed property; proficiency with a Versatile-only weapon held in two hands does not satisfy that gate. Record the qualifying proficiency grant and weapon profile/type in the acquisition snapshot. These are acquisition credentials: they neither supply an item or proficiency nor make an otherwise unproficient attack proficient. They do not impose a new requirement to use the acquisition-qualifying weapon for every later feat event. Actual use-time weapon, proficiency where expressly required, grip, body, range, ammunition, action and other predicates remain those of the exact feat and governing procedure. All other printed ability, level, prerequisite-feat, class-access and earned-opportunity requirements remain mandatory. Class, feat, ancestry and item grants with similar names otherwise remain separate permissions.
Casting-prerequisite snapshot bridge — FEAT327-ACQ-03. NEW acquisition completion. Apply this bridge only to an actual feat acquisition prerequisite or its expressly required acquisition selection, subject to a more specific acquisition rule in that feat’s final procedure. A casting prerequisite requires a source-qualified personal spellcasting entitlement already acquired by the character and still retained at the acquisition snapshot. Record the actual grant, exact spell identity and source version, casting route, relevant class/rank gates, and the repertoire or preparation evidence that makes that route available. Class-level capacity, an RP or RC pool, a spell merely appearing on a permitted list, ownership of a spellbook or scroll, item-enabled casting, an unacquired class feature, and the prospective benefit of the feat being acquired do not by themselves supply this entitlement.

Retained entitlement versus immediate casting legality. A retained personal grant does not lose its acquisition credential merely because its renewable charge is currently empty, RP is insufficient, components or a suitable casting hand/voice are unavailable, the character is unconscious, or an existing temporary prohibition or suppression prevents casting. Ignore those immediate-use impediments only when evaluating this casting credential. Do not refill a resource, restore components, lift a prohibition, perform a cast, or establish that the feat-selection transaction itself is otherwise lawful. Actual casting still requires every current action, component, body, target, range, payment, concentration, strain and source-specific condition. An expressly ongoing or currently-active prerequisite in a particular feat remains an ongoing or currently-active prerequisite.

Qualifying repertoire and preparation. For a known-spell route, require the exact spell actually learned or personally granted, with its applicable source gates satisfied. For an ordinary prepared route, require the spell actually prepared at the snapshot, an actually acquired always-prepared grant, or another already-established source exception that authorizes casting it without ordinary preparation. An unprepared spellbook entry and the ability to prepare or substitute it later are insufficient for that spell’s credential. A future study period, rest, substitution, level-up selection or other repertoire change cannot be anticipated. A ritual route qualifies when the character actually possesses its ritual-casting permission and the particular spell meets that permission’s exact book, tag, rank and other repertoire requirements; no ritual need already have been cast. Do not extend one spell’s ritual overlay to another spell. Loss of a required repertoire source follows the actual class procedure: Wizard’s surviving prepared matrices remain available under its spellbook-loss rule, while an unprepared lost-book entry is not made available by merely planning its reconstruction.

Generic and specific predicates. “Spellcasting ability,” “Actual personal spellcasting ability,” and “Ability to cast at least one spell” require at least one qualifying personal spell route under this bridge; a qualifying rank-0 spell is sufficient. “Ability to cast cantrips” requires a qualifying rank-0 route. A named-spell prerequisite requires the exact required spell identity and permitted source version, not a similarly named class technique or item effect. A school prerequisite requires an actual matching school on the qualifying route. A rank prerequisite uses the spell rank actually supplied by that route and the final normalized predicate’s existing exact-rank or minimum-rank comparison, not total character level, maximum possible class rank, available RP, damage, or a higher price paid for a lower-rank spell. Where one predicate combines identity, school, rank or route restrictions, one qualifying route must satisfy that complete predicate; do not combine different routes’ most favorable fields. Distinct alternatives retain their existing AND/OR structure.

Removal, replacement and expiry. Reevaluate the retained grant and repertoire for every new feat acquisition. An actually removed, expired or lawfully retrained-away grant cannot support a new acquisition unless another independently qualifying route exists. Replacing a prepared matrix removes that ordinary prepared route for later snapshots unless another valid route to the spell remains. Temporary suppression or renewable depletion is not removal. Exhausting a genuinely nonrenewable permission follows its actual source: if the permission terminates, it no longer supplies a retained route. Under FS-01, a previously acquired feat keeps its original acquisition snapshot; later prerequisite loss does not erase that historical acquisition or waive any of the feat’s actual ongoing operating conditions.

Unassigned schools and required school choices. Preserve each source spell’s actual school value, explicit null or absent field. An absent, null or unassigned school is not Universal, Enchantment, Evocation, a wildcard, or a school inferred from damage type or a grant’s name. A school-unassigned personal rank-0 grant can satisfy generic spellcasting and cantrip predicates, but cannot itself satisfy a school-specific predicate. Supplementary Spell Focus additionally requires its mandatory permanent selection of an actual school supported by at least one qualifying acquired spell route at that same snapshot. Satisfying its generic spellcasting prerequisite without a supported school choice is insufficient to complete its acquisition. Another genuine route may support that choice. Subsequent loss or suppression of the supporting route does not reselect the school or erase the original acquisition; later benefits still require actual eligible casts through that fixed school.

Authored-candidate evidence versus runtime selection. For authored-candidate qualification, use the exact complete controlling authored spell procedure and its actual source-access binding, supported by the applicable review and fulfillment chain. A preserved earlier blocked catalog snapshot does not override an explicitly reviewed, version-linked operational descendant merely because the original remains unchanged. A separate selectionEnabled:false or disabled runtime adapter does not by itself invalidate that authored evidence. Neither a favorable label nor the existence of a reviewed spell supplies the character’s personal grant or repertoire history. Genuinely unfinished, null, unsupported or operationally unavailable payloads remain unavailable as positive casting witnesses. Preserve original statuses and live selection flags; this acquisition bridge neither enables runtime selection nor promotes another card.

Snapshot and payment. Preserve the exact prerequisite text and record the qualifying grant, spell/source/mode, actual school-field state and rank, repertoire/preparation or ritual basis, applicable class gates, controlling authored-procedure reference, and acquisition time. Temporary use blocks may be recorded separately but are not treated as grant removal. Missing grant, preparation, source-version or required-school evidence leaves that predicate unestablished rather than assumed true. Check all other printed ability, level, ownership, credential and earned-opportunity requirements independently. The feat’s own prospective spell grant cannot bootstrap its prerequisite, and one paid opportunity cannot fund two acquisitions.

For the six exploration training entries, snapshot each named skill separately at acquisition: grant proficiency if absent; grant the explicitly printed replacing Expertise only if already proficient. An acquired proficiency does not become Expertise merely because proficiency is later acquired elsewhere. If a fixed grant lacks that branch, duplication yields no replacement skill or Expertise. Skill Expert and Prodigy's ordered explicit selections use their own rules. Study, tutoring, language learning, formula research, copying and crafting are different tasks; a bonus or time discount on one does not migrate to another. Apply the actual minimum phase, calendar, rest and physical requirements.

External-credential evidence — FEAT327-ACQ-04. NEW evidence-contract completion; the four existing feat procedures and their prerequisite alternatives are retained. For frenzied_rage, divine_favor, elemental_body and dragon_blood, evaluate a required external credential under ACQ04-EC1 against the same character, world and ordered acquisition snapshot, using the exact operative prerequisite and source version, linked credential or event evidence, and that world's established authority for recording that fact. A source file establishes wording, not that a particular character acquired a feature, worships a deity, experienced an event or possesses a lineage. A name, nonempty story label, unchecked Boolean, prospective feat benefit or unrelated class/ancestry/item grant supplies no credential. The supporting grant, worship state or exposure event must already qualify before acquisition; same-time events require an authoritative earlier sequence. Worship must be established at that snapshot; exposure is a qualifying prior event, not a requirement to remain exposed. Apply the branch-specific facts and required choices in ACQ04-EC1 without adding doctrine, an exposure threshold, an element-to-plane matching rule or a legacy alias. A conditional, opaque test-world fixture can establish only a CONDITIONAL_ONLY predicate result within that fixture. It supplies no actual campaign history, selectable option, class feature, cosmology approval or entitlement. Missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient evidence leaves a predicate UNESTABLISHED; affirmative incompatible evidence is CONTRADICTED. Neither result satisfies a required AND node, although a separately satisfied printed OR alternative remains valid. An ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT result requires independently admitted actual-world evidence and is not supplied by this review. Preserve all original source fields, absence/null distinctions, acquisition history and current status/selection flags. All other permanent-ability, level, parent-feat, mandatory-choice and earned-opportunity predicates remain independently required; one paid opportunity cannot fund two acquisitions. Later use still requires the exact feat's ongoing predicates. This evidence policy does not reopen ACQ-03 or change its casting-snapshot rules.

NEW FEAT335-ACQUISITION-AUDIT-01 profile-classification bridge, limited to Weapon Focus and Weapon Mastery: a specific unarmed-strike profile is an eligible choice when it is supplied by an actual current operative source and actual acquired proficiency covers it. The source-listed ordinary Unarmed strike remains a Simple melee training entry even though it is an attack option rather than an inventory object. An actual Simple-weapons proficiency grant covering that entry, or an express unarmed-strike proficiency grant, supplies the required training. An actually acquired Monk unarmed rule changes that same unarmed attack's operative statistics; its die progression alone is not a new paid profile or a free reselection. An acquired Troll Claws trait, explicitly used to make unarmed strikes, is an eligible specific Claws profile when the actor also has that actual unarmed-strike training. Bind both the real trait/body and its covering training grant; Claws alone grants no proficiency. No separate external training credential is necessary when those current-source grants already establish it. Another genuine natural profile remains source-qualified: require its actual profile and covering proficiency, whether an explicit unarmed bridge or another actual grant; neither an umbrella label nor this ruling supplies all-natural-weapon proficiency. No item, anatomy, attack or combined Monk/Claws damage formula is granted. Weapon Focus retains its express ongoing operative-proficiency requirement. Weapon Mastery checks proficiency at acquisition and retains its own matching-profile and total-level-six use predicates, without a new ongoing-proficiency gate. Its nonrepeatability, broadest applicable critical range, natural-19-meets-AC and natural-20-automatic-hit rules are unchanged.

rules.title: Distinct feat bonuses and retained comparison families
rules.wording:
NEW joint convention: after eligibility, flat numeric bonuses from DISTINCT feat identities add unless an explicit shared comparison family says otherwise. One feat identity contributes once to the same event/statistic across duplicate representations, sources and owners. This replaces Extended Magic's blanket strongest-same-stat proposal and the conflicting individual statements/examples named in the correction register. It does not rewrite the eight reviewed feats or reviewed maximum-HP components.
Class techniques still perform their own strongest-class-bonus comparison; spells perform their reviewed same-stat comparison; item, attire, tool, facility, cover and item-enhancement contributions retain their own reviewed families. Then add the independently legal feat contribution. A feat-created weapon/armor enhancement explicitly put into an equipment family remains there, not also a feat bonus. Same named condition penalties retain their own comparison rather than becoming additive because a feat created them. Advantage/disadvantage still cancel normally; more sources of advantage do not outvote one disadvantage. Damage resistance of the same scope applies once; immunity retains priority; keep the greatest remaining temporary HP, not their sum. Expanded critical ranges use the broadest applicable range rather than adding chance points. Copies cannot exploit a new family name to duplicate a source. Actual unusual source overrides retain their explicitly narrower predicates.

rules.title: Native damage, percentages and hostile slows
rules.wording:
NEW percentage convention: each separately eligible percentage feat computes its own floored increment from the SAME native packet, after actual critical-dice adjustment and its ordinary native ability/flat formula but BEFORE external riders, other percentage increments, saves and defenses. Add the increments; never multiply them together or floor a combined percentage instead of the separate increments. A feat's exact eligible base remains controlling: Anatomy Lore and Precision Strike do not acquire a giant-slayer multiplier on unrelated spells, for example. Added external Smite/sneak/copy/retaliation/rider packets do not enter another feat's native base unless expressly named. Apply a shared-area roll's increment once to that shared roll, then each actual target's save/defenses. For a mixed native packet requiring division, compute the increment once, distribute proportional to nonnegative native typed amounts by largest remainder with original component order breaking ties, and preserve integer totals. Do not add the full increment to each type. Additional dice are added before actual critical doubling and save fractions; a maximized die is not an actually rolled face for rolled-face triggers.
KEEP hostile slow arbitration: evaluate each adverse Speed effect against the same pre-control Speed and take the lowest surviving result; do not add Slasher and Crippling Strike's two -10 penalties, or subtract -10 again after a stronger half-Speed. Distinct records retain their own deadlines and suppression. Root/physical restraint, missing movement modes, terrain costs, burden, systemic Strain and actual Wounds retain their proper independent stages. No movement already spent is refunded. Percent damage addition is not the rule for percentage work/cost/consumption reductions: those use their specifically declared strongest-factor family.

rules.title: Roll type, reroll window and targets
rules.wording:
KEEP attacks versus AC, binary saves, fixed-DC Core tasks with natural shifts, and opposed totals with unchanged-state ties lost by the initiator. A +10 attack margin is not a critical. Natural 1/20 on attacks retain their attack rules; saves do not acquire task shifts. A failed-save reroll replaces the whole original one- or two-d20 procedure with the same actual modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, before consequences, unless the exact feat instead replaces a named die position. Use the replacement even if worse; a source cannot reroll its own replacement. Lucky and Elven Accuracy keep their separately specified die-position rules. Costs and prior consequences are not rolled back.
KEEP the current class target convention: 'ally' includes the owner unless the source says OTHER, or real geometry/activity inherently requires a different creature. Do not count the same person twice in 'you and an ally', a team, a flanking pair or an assistance role. 'Enemy' requires an actual current opponent, not every creature in range; meaningful-hostility and anti-farm gates apply only where the source/this register binds resource or encounter rewards. Do not add an enemy or anatomy gate to an unrelated ordinary attack merely as a blanket convention. Source perception, actual reach/line of effect, body eligibility and willing/understood channels remain real.

rules.title: One clock, deadlines, rests and initial uses
rules.wording:
Use EX58's single elapsed clock, eight-hour Watches, actual task minutes, two-active-work-Watch ceiling and scheduled Rest. A change of scene, gate, holder, location, initiative, class representation or calendar label does not reset a resource. SR/LR in these new procedures mean the actual beneficial completed owner rest, with one beneficial Long Rest per 24 elapsed hours and at most two beneficial Short Rests between beneficial Long Rests. A qualifying long rest restores a short-rest allowance as already governed. Extra safe Rest paying Rest Debt alone provides no second resource recovery. Recipient-rest limits use the actual named recipient's rest epoch.
NEW initial acquisition completion: the newly acquired limited-use feat begins with its specified full finite allowance, unless it expressly starts empty (such as accumulated stacks/charges). Reacquisition/alias duplication cannot initialize it again. An increase in a PB-based maximum increases capacity only, not current unspent uses. Genuine maximum-HP/RP/RC, Hit Die, reserve and slot changes never heal or refill unrelated current values.
Use each explicit own-turn/any-turn/round predicate literally. A per-round allowance has one numbered global-round identity; extra turns do not refresh it. A default 'your turn' feat allowance uses the owner's regular interval unless its exact source direction expressly retains any actual turn. Newly completed missing durations use the next future original regular marker specified by the row, not the already-underway marker, retaining virtual/absolute deadlines across schedule changes. Outside initiative use the governed six-second phase without double ticks. A missed trigger is not queued for later. An early ending does not refund time or a use.

NEW FEAT335-CADENCE-CHECK-01 completion, limited to feat procedures governed by FS-06: an otherwise unqualified "once per turn" allowance is once for that feat owner during each genuine actual creature turn in which its exact trigger legally occurs, whether that turn belongs to the owner or another creature. A separately sourced and actually occurring extra turn has a distinct actual-turn identity and can supply a distinct opportunity for that unqualified allowance; this rule grants no extra turn. Another Action, Bonus Action, attack, Reaction, nested event, target or resumed segment of the same actual turn does not create another turn identity. Returning to or replaying an already recorded turn retains that turn's spent claim. Actual body, movement, attack, casting, payment, causal-root and recipient restrictions still govern independently.

This completion does not replace an expressly regular-turn allowance or FS-06's existing default owner-regular-interval allowance for "your turn". In particular, Savage Attacker retains its stated own/off-turn regular-turn allowances, and Eldritch Combat retains its expressly regular-creature-turn shared embedded-cast cap plus its owner-regular-interval ordinary-append cap. Overrun's per-creature challenge limit belongs to the actual turn containing its qualifying Dash and subsequent movement; another Dash in that same turn does not renew it. Quickened Thought keeps its expressly any-later-actual-turn release window and the shared one-free-stored-release-per-owner/numbered-round cap, not a new bank at each turn. Per-round, encounter, underlying-roll/cast, recipient-rest and source-defined duration/deadline histories are not reset by an extra turn. Outside initiative retain the governed six-second procedure without inventing a turn from each action or counting an initiative transition twice. Source-specific temporal restoration remains separately governed; this completion supplies no rewind or unsupported extra-turn adapter.

rules.title: Damage, current capacity, healing and causal budgets
rules.wording:
Keep the reviewed damage/prevention/temp-HP/HP/Wound/death order and exact immunity/resistance/interception windows. Numeric actual damage means actual normal HP lost plus actual temporary HP absorbed, excluding overkill, damage prevented and mere state assignments. That metric never defeats an explicit no-resource origin, no-trigger ward/temp-HP rule or other causal prohibition: only source-qualified events can fund a resource benefit. Preserve those flags through every descendant. Capacity changes are not damage or healing. Ordinary healing observes actual blockers, modifiers, finite reserves and the Critical ceiling; direct state recovery is identified separately and remains subject to broad HP-gain prohibition. A successful stabilization or life-state change does not silently remove Wounds, Prone or another unconsciousness cause.
NEW common anti-loop binding for the new feat rewards: preserve original actor, paid event and target; no staged cooperative threat, vanished/no-resource body, copied packet, reflected retaliation, cost damage or manufactured repeat kill supplies another free resource, attack, healing conversion or reset. Explicit independent printed exceptions are listed in the relevant row, not inferred by name. A root's refunded RP cannot exceed the real unrefunded payment eligible for that particular refund, and headroom still caps restoration. One refund record cannot be spent twice by Arcane Resonance and Arcane Recall. A new feat supplies no RP pool. Reactions require actual availability; specifically passive post-zero registration/recovery exceptions do not grant an Action or Reaction at zero HP. Automatic death processing still precedes later generic regeneration unless the exact source supplies the narrow earlier recovery window.

rules.title: Ordinary casts, feat casts, copies and reflection
rules.wording:
Ordinary casts retain their exact class/repertoire/school/rank, actual class-level gate, components, paid RP/material/independent costs, concentration transition and Dissonance/Refrain before the counter window. Ready casts at preparation, not release; resuming a pending parent never erases nested chronological casting history. A named class spell and an ordinary spell do not merge permissions or prices. The 71 higher-spell drafts remain comparisons only. Current LRX standalone full-mode records remain intact; a null legacy operational field is not permission to discard their operationalCandidate representation or to install a lossy adapter.
NEW exception to Extended Magic's overbroad copy sentence: releasing Eldritch Echo/Mimicry's permitted temporary profile is a NEW paid, caster-owned FEAT COPY CAST, with its own actual components, chosen profile rank, one concentration slot, ordinary quote and Dissonance/Refrain. It is not the source caster's full spell and does not grant their class access. Mark it copy-derived: it creates no further copy/capture, ordinary class cast-proc, action grant, item/creature/resource/healing-conversion chain or external feat damage amplification. Its direct bounded payload and normal target defenses still operate. By contrast Echo Spell and Twin Cast's permitted secondary resolution and Spell Deflection/Reflection redirection are not new casts and do not repay/update history. They keep original owner/printed snapshot as specified. The reviewed Mirrorsage Echo Release remains its own actual class spell/cost/Dissonance procedure, not this new feat profile. No generic copy rule overrides that source.
Repeated copies/redirects retain a causal root and one recorded permitted branch. A reflected spell cannot reflect again. A copied spell cannot fill the copy slot. Missing or excluded payloads, unknown rank, a non-spell ability or a resource-generating spell are not silently converted into eligible full spells.

rules.title: Feat-only grants, schools and casting prices
rules.wording:
ADOPT the supplied bounded feat-casting route as NEW. Choose and record the exact curriculum where applicable, spell identity and source version, grant rank and permanent casting ability at acquisition from the allowed source-linked list. Preserve the source’s actual school value, explicit null or absent school field; recording source identity does not authorize assigning a missing school. Apply FEAT327-ACQ-03 to casting-prerequisite snapshots and required school selections. Preserve every curriculum’s exact permitted spell, class placement, mode and casting ability; this clarification does not enlarge a curriculum or waive a required source-linked choice. It gives only that feat's repertoire/charge, no ordinary class levels, rank progression, RP pool, prepared positions or class engine. Generic and named Magic Initiate for the same curriculum share one acquisition entitlement; a different name cannot give duplicate charges for that same grant. Actual source-specific versions/modes/components/range remain; no lowest-price or school-union shortcut. Named Sorcerer/Warlock curricula are limited feat lists, not newly created classes. When a granted payload explicitly scales by casting class level, NEW feat route uses total character level only for that payload's printed scaling; it invents no scaling otherwise.
A finite 'cast without RP' grant waives its normal rank/ordinary price and price-derived Dissonance surcharge only, not an explicitly consumed independent RP payment such as Resonance Shield's 1 RP, Silent/Still surcharge, material, maintenance, blood cost or charge. The feat route uses actual total PB and its specified ability, DC8+PB+ability, attackPB+ability. With no acquired class casting-engine override for that feat route, NEW base Dissonance is0 for rank0,1 for ranks1–5 and2 for ranks6–9; use ordinary Refrain and Limit=max(4,2PB+casting modifier), including the governed ranked-block threshold and component/interruption rules. Being a Wizard does not make an independently acquired feat charge a prepared Wizard matrix.
For ordinary priced spells, apply actual existing discounts, Dissonance-price addition, source independent additions, armor and final source multipliers in their reviewed order; apply Efficient Caster only at its stated stage to an actual price of at least2 and never below1 at that stage. Heighten substitutes only the proper ordinary class route's higher base rank-price, not the identity/rank of the resulting spell or a fictitious price for a free charge. Silent and Still each add1 real independent RP when used; they do not pay themselves from a zero-capacity pool. Keep source-specific minimum prices and no-refund rules.

rules.title: Actions, command channels, mounts and personal movement
rules.wording:
Keep one additional FULL Action per creature/numbered round and the existing prohibition on additional Actions generating another additional Action/Bonus Action/Reaction. A source that explicitly grants a separate later Bonus Action has only its named window. Free attacks are not full Actions and cannot recursively grant other free attacks unless an exact existing exception says so. Ordinary Attack Action, card technique, weapon attack, spell attack and cantrip are not interchangeable labels.
Use one physical creature identity, controller record, movement pool and authoritative phase. All controlled companions retain the governed shared Bonus Action command and one offensive/control companion action per owner/round. A source may command two bodies for nonoffensive actions only where stated; it does not grant two offensive actions. The feat owner must actually send the required audible/visible/mental channel; known language, trained signals, Silence and source range matter. Existing Tinker devices use actual reviewed channels and shared budgets.
A bonded animal may be a mount only if its actual body, training, size, seat, tack, load and access meet EX58. It does not gain a second phase for being both companion and mount. Register the applicable EX58 mounted-control phase before operation; do not switch schemas midround to obtain unused budgets. Unmounted feat companions use the explicitly supplied after-owner-regular-turn phase. Mount and rider remain separate targets and actor budgets. Cavalry adds10 to each ACTUAL existing mount locomotion Speed while legally ridden, before applicable burden, terrain and later multipliers; it creates no mode, carrying capacity or engine. Route pace uses the actual resulting limiting profile under EX58, not a second free journey. The rider's being carried is not personal walking, Dragoon Momentum or a movement-cost discount. Mount/dismount uses the actual half-current-walk movement cost, access, one-per-regular-interval allowance and fitting seat; an extra Action does not reset it.

rules.title: Forage, Supply, survival and depletion
rules.wording:
KEEP EX58 quantities: a Small/Medium ordinary daily need is2lb edible food and8pints potable water; Large needs double. One full Supply also contains1pint compatible lamp oil and0.25lb camp sundries, which are not produced by foraging or reduced by Survivalist. Oil burns on actual use at1pint/6hours; spare stock is not erased at daily settlement. Two pounds food equal three reviewed Cooking servings. Actual human/animal diets, timestamps, contamination, safe receivers, custody, carry/load and corpse/site history remain distinct.
ADOPT Forager's NEW480-active-minute qualified finite guarantee: at most14lb edible food and56pints potable water, no yield roll, when both actual available stocks and lawful safe access support it. It replaces only the ordinary yield outcome, not hazards, harvesting restrictions, transport or actual labor. An area with only one resource supplies only that real available component up to the cap, never the absent other component; scarcity shortfalls are explicit, not another roll minting matter. Deserts/arctic use ordinary methods, not this guarantee. Reserve and debit actual disjoint resource pools; changing owners/trades/names never reopens forfeited stock. One holder's next guaranteed completion is at least24 elapsed hours after its prior completion, with a real new480minutes and remaining stock. Survivalist halves only that holder's food/water demand to1lb/4pints (Large2lb/8pints), strongest requirement reduction once, with no free rest/protection against impossible hazards. Cooking and preservation do not multiply food or reset its age. Only expressly named mapping/tracking concurrency can accompany travel; one Watch cannot also fund unrelated foraging, crafting or rest.

rules.title: Endurance: explicit EX58 checkpoint adaptation
rules.wording:
NEW explicit replacement for GD-09's hypothetical half-speed no-water timer: the source phrase 'twice as long' is implemented against EX58's actual deprivation PENALTY EVENTS, not by inventing a second elapsed calendar or changing when daily needs/Rest Debt are recorded. Keep canonical24-hour food/water settlement, scheduled Rest, debt-opening time, second-following-Watch deadline, later missed-Rest deadline resets, real safe8-hour repayment and work limits unchanged.
Maintain two owner-specific bounded credits: foodWaterPending in{0,1}, and sleepPending in{0,1}, initially0 when first legally acquired with no prior debt forgiven. At a canonical daily settlement deficient in food or water, first determine the source's single1-Strain shortfall, not one per need. If Endurance is operative and this penalty has no independent non-food/water cause, toggle foodWaterPending:0→1 prevents that one Strain;1→0 permits the original1 Strain. A genuinely fully food-and-water-supported day clears the pending credit. Missing mandatory non-food/water support still imposes the original daily1 Strain regardless of this feat, never adds a second daily Strain, and does not falsely count as a supported day. Actual partial consumption and unsupported-day recovery restrictions remain.
For each distinct canonical sleep-deprivation1-Strain event (an unpaid due deadline or another missed scheduled Rest while indebted), apply the same0→1 prevent /1→0 original1 rule to sleepPending, with no new event created and no cancellation of the debt/deadline update. Genuine safe8-hour debt-clearing Rest clears sleepPending, even if it grants no additional beneficial rest rewards. Reaching a due boundary still marks that event evaluated once. If Endurance is absent/suppressed at a checkpoint, apply the original penalty and clear that cause's pending credit; prior prevented/inflicted Strain is never replayed. The two causes cannot pay each other's counter. Previous Strain, established debt and spent rest rewards remain.
This is an expressly NEW narrowing of the generic timing promise to half-frequency canonical penalty events: it does NOT assert that irregular emergency-based sleep deadlines themselves become exactly twice as many elapsed hours. It preserves EX58 rather than silently substituting the draft's nonexistent24-hour no-water timer. Gain advantage on actual CON saves to prevent/resist the Exhaustion condition; environmental Strain qualifies only if its actual source expressly makes that CON save an exhaustion save. Automatic shortage/debt gains create no save. Dissonance, Warrior serum Strain and differently scoped injury saves do not acquire this advantage. Other explicit deprivation-damage/air/hazard clocks are unchanged; the feat does not grant breathing, nutrition, thermal immunity or extra work/rest credit.

rules.title: Appraisal, bargaining, social outcomes and settlement
rules.wording:
ADOPT Appraise's explicit NEW ten-active-minute item identification/appraisal, separate from the current Action-range Identify spell. It can discover actual unprotected operative magical properties and curses as specified in its exact row; it is not a Divination spell by name and does not infer history, secret identities or cosmology. Source-specific identification protections still apply. Use the row's10/15/20/25 standalone DC fallback only where no actual controlling task/item DC exists. Within Haven's appraisal operation use its actual source/task DC (explicit or tier12/13/15/16/18/19), retain the FULL30-minute lot/item procedure, and count the holder's ten-minute inspection as a real nonoverlapping subtask inside it when the same person/work actually satisfies both. No second roll is created by the label.
A ten-minute bargaining feat likewise occupies only its real subtask of the full30-minute Haven disposition; record the remainder for inspection, agreement and transfer. It does not halve those30minutes or remove provenance, hearing, claims, settlement, sponsor/tax/assay or worker shifts. Standalone transactions can use their own actual procedure without inventing compulsory Haven fees. Predeclare the attainable concession, DC, price basis and costs; on success honor the promised outcome, not a newly imposed 'costly agreement' after the roll. No check compels impossible terms, an absent seller or a player belief. Standing remains EX58 -3..+3 with signed per-scene award bounded±2; aliases and background initialization never erase earned history.
Reference value, actual offer, sale gross and net receipts remain separate. Use exact rational currency until the final purchase-ceiling/sale-floor copper rounding. Apply a named discount once to its agreed eligible basis, never to taxes or paid fees by association. Keep the actual greater-of assay rule and sponsor deductions from EX58-EDIT-02; no10% fine cap is revived. Known properties do not mint stock, title, formula knowledge, free service, wages or a guaranteed buyer.

rules.title: Real work, crafting/repair and time reductions
rules.wording:
Use actual artisan/non-artisan credentials, source recipe DC/inputs/assistant caps/maximum ordered complete bodies, incorporation phase and hours. Feat proficiency does not make a non-artisan credential an artisan tool. A reduction to a named work category changes only its active minutes. For competing same-purpose fractional work/material reductions take the strongest permitted factor once, not their product; distinct time and material bases remain separate. Fixed calendar/waiting/access requirements are not shortened. Retain real minimum physical phases: never omit the actual first15-minute incorporation or make a reduced task finish before its necessary work. Unfinished phases, actual loss and return clocks remain. No third work Watch, automatic research evidence, recipe, learner, assistant, XP or free body is created.
KEEP Tinker Adept's explicitly NEW at-most30-active-minute exception inside the holder's actual beneficial Short Rest: only an entire independently authorized repair whose required active work fits that allowance qualifies. The whole repair uses actual tools, materials, safe compatible light activity and current body; do not stage the last30minutes of an eight-hour repair inside Rest to claim this exception. Add PB only to successful structural CURRENT-HP restoration up to existing maximum, once; ordinary full-restoration repairs often gain0 additional HP. It changes no missing-primary requirement, charge, service, dawn counter, fuel, custody or terminal dismantling history. Repair, maintenance, servicing and rest are different transitions. Existing finite source body/condition/pricing and structural damage-deficit rules remain controlling. Bowyer/Master Smithing and the three Trapsetter bodies use only their expressly NEW closed processes and stocks, not unprinted equivalents of all687 recipes.

rules.title: Hard denial, reactive awards and physical hazards
rules.wording:
Keep the reviewed source-character/target/encounter hard whole-Action/turn-denial guard for these newly authored feat control procedures; a new feat spelling or trap body does not create a second allowance. Explicit Haste voluntary ending-cost exceptions and other already-reviewed exact exceptions retain their own scope. Stagger, a slow or loss of future Reactions is not automatically whole-Action denial. Existing committed Reactions on a stack are not retroactively erased by future-Reaction prohibition.
KEEP source equipment procedures. Ordinary locks use their actual key/Action or thieves'-tools Action/DC15 procedure, not Burglar's obsolete one-minute fallback. Caltrops remain real hazards after a trigger; neither replacement, a spent quick-placement allowance nor a remote ownership declaration deletes/moves their20pieces. Trapsetter's exact amended row supplies real disarming/collection and bounded independent snare/charge procedures. Mere motion of a container or a feature name does not create a device command channel. Physical access, footing, body defenses and actual target/custody remain required before any quoted task or attack.

rules.title: Private data, deferred payloads and exact-candidate gate
rules.wording:
The two original feats astral_projection and planar_binding retain complete literal sources and finite grant wrappers, but their cosmology-dependent spell payloads remain null/unavailable. Do not invent planes, patrons, soul currency, Voice or hidden meanings for any feat. Other named references can be operational receipts without receiving a cosmology interpretation. Spell Focus, feat-only Eldritch Blast, Detect Thoughts' proposed feat-only profile and the closed animal/gadget/maneuver/copy/flora tables are explicitly NEW supplements, not silently inserted original catalog records. Preserve all comparison class/feat/spell statuses.
Source directions authorize assembling the complete exact candidate: all327 identities, with325 complete supported procedures and two explicit unavailable wrappers, full public/internal envelopes, originals/question maps, this convention set, complete supplements and corrected660examples. The separate exact review remains required before any whole-feat promotion; this source verdict grants no conditional promotion merely for passing static tests. Genuine actual anatomy, actor ownership, source acquisition, required teacher/provider, safe handling, real material, known spell and lawful world access remain use-time predicates. An unsupported particular operation stays unavailable without reopening this completed source conference. Runtime implementation, human teaching/balance, remaining catalogs, DD01 and whole-game flow are separate. Final joint whole-game agreement precedes the already-authorized push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology. No extra owner-confirmation gate is introduced.

completeSelectedPublicRecords.name: Mental Buffer

sourceObject.name: Mental Buffer
sourceObject.description: Wisdom 15+ supports the feat's listed once-per-day defense against confusion.
sourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, when you would become confused, dominated, or unable to distinguish allies from enemies, ignore that condition until the end of your next turn.

After an actual successful legal reflection or capture of a spell/supernatural effect through a separately owned source, gain resistance to the one real damage type expressed by its selected copied/reflected component until your next future regular end. NEW choose one observed type for a mixed packet; nondamaging effects grant no damage resistance. It begins after capture/redirect, does not retroactively mitigate earlier damage, and grants no copying permission by itself. Once SR/LR at that event, also mark the one legal captured profile as temporarily known through your second future regular start. During that interval you may activate that exact bounded profile using its actual action, RP, components, rank ceiling and concentration, even if its original one-use record was consumed; no other original spell/monster ability is learned. Each activation is a copy retaining the original no-proc/no-copy/resource flags and the shared one-copy-release/round cap below. Existing Mirrorsage records retain their actual release costs/caps and printed bounded profile. No restoration of archive slots or legacy boss power. Expiry removes permission but not legitimately established effects before their own deadlines.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

Copying a harmless warning reveals no damage type and grants no invented resistance.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.
